disease.name: Bladder cancer

disease.tissue_class: mucosal-tissue-class (urothelial epithelium plus lamina propria); cell-of-origin = urothelium classified as secretory class (H_min = 0.843264) per the EpiSCORE BladderRef Epi tile assignment
disease.subtypes_supported: v0.2 covers urothelial carcinoma broadly (papillary, flat, in-situ, invasive). NMIBC vs MIBC stratification deferred to v0.3 pending TCGA-BLCA stage-stratified re-analysis. Squamous-differentiated, glandular, micropapillary, sarcomatoid, plasmacytoid, neuroendocrine variant histologies not separately characterized in v0.2.

universal_pipeline_acknowledgment.note: The Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3 pipeline is invariant across all cards. See universal_reference block below for canonical specification.

stage_1_immune_flag.panel: Xu-538 (panel ID Xu2020_breast_cancer_replicated_full); 538 CpGs from Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. Blood DNA Methylation and Breast Cancer: A Prospective Case-Cohort Analysis in the Sister Study. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94. doi: 10.1093/jnci/djz065. PMID 30989176.
stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method: pooled-entropy A_immune via Shannon symmetry; no per-CpG directional scoring at Stage 1
stage_1_immune_flag.note_for_bladder: On the TCGA-BLCA HM450K sesame Level 3 cohort, the Xu-538 panel exhibited 78.0% mean per-sample coverage with 51.1% pass rate at the ≥80% per-sample CHK-3.1B threshold. Per VAL-120 sealed outcome (O4_STAGE1_DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE), the v0.1 Stage 1 panel does NOT pass production deployment for HM450 bladder cohorts. The diagnostic Stage 1 paired contrast d_paired = +1.8977 (n=21, p=3.14e-08) is consistent with bladder cancer's heavy tumor-infiltrating-lymphocyte biology and is reported as diagnostic in v0.2. Production Stage 1 deployment for bladder requires a bladder-cohort-coverage-validated panel (v0.3 promotion path) — DISC-BLADDER-004 propagates as CHK-2.17 cookbook gate.
stage_1_immune_flag.expected_direction_for_bladder: POSITIVE — tumor A_immune higher than adjacent-normal A_immune, consistent with chronic immune activation from heavy TIL infiltration. Bladder Stage 1 paired magnitude (+1.90) is 3.8× larger than prostate Stage 1 (+0.50, VAL-058) on the same panel — bladder TIL infiltration is documented to be more aggressive than typical prostate adenocarcinoma's immune microenvironment.

stage_2_localization.primary_atlas_family_for_bladder: gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas (EpiSCORE BladderRef) — required as primary cell-of-origin reader on mucosal cohorts per CHK-2.18. Bulk-WGBS atlases (Loyfer, Caggiano TIM) remain in atlases_run for triangulation but cannot be the headline signal.

loyfer_bulk_bladder_tile.status: TRIANGULATION-ONLY on mucosal cohorts per CHK-2.18; NEVER primary cell-of-origin reader
loyfer_bulk_bladder_tile.calibration_anchor: VAL-112 (sealed 2026-04-29 on TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3)
loyfer_bulk_bladder_tile.note: Bulk-tissue WGBS reference. On TCGA-BLCA mucosal cohort, Loyfer Bladder tile fired POSITIVE +1.91 paired d = bulk-substrate distribution mismatch artifact (DISC-BLADDER-003), NOT cell-of-origin biology. CHK-3.2 cross-tile sanity confirmed: ALL 14 non-bladder Loyfer solid-tissue tiles also fired POSITIVE FIRES at d_paired +2.34 to +2.92 — substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal-cohort substrate, not cross-tissue cell-of-origin signal.

stage_2_localization.expected_direction_for_bladder_cell_of_o: BladderRef Epi tile NEGATIVE direction (urothelial-program loss in tumor, CCL-039 cell-of-origin expectation). Microenvironment tiles (EC, Fib, IC) POSITIVE direction (CCL-039 microenvironment expansion). Pattern is structurally identical to prostate VAL-118 LE-NEGATIVE + BE/EC/Fib/Leu/SM-POSITIVE pattern.

DETECTABLE_tier.trigger: Stage 1 A_immune ≥ 1.05 of age-matched 80-cell baseline (operational tier; v0.1 Stage 1 panel coverage limitation does not affect tier formula)
DETECTABLE_tier.clinical_action: Urology consult. Urinalysis with cytology if not already performed. Cystoscopy per AUA/EAU early-detection guidelines for symptomatic patients. Patient-stratified by age + smoking history + occupational-exposure history (aromatic amines, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons).

ELEVATED_tier.trigger: Stage 1 A_immune ≥ 1.07 OR Stage 2 BladderRef Epi tile A-score BELOW q5 of VAL-119 healthy floor (q5 = 0.4004)
ELEVATED_tier.clinical_action: Expedited urology referral within 4 weeks. Urinalysis + cytology + cystoscopy. Imaging (CT urogram or MRI) at urologist discretion. UroMark methylation panel (clinical-grade comparator, Feber 2017) on voided urine if locally available — see CHK-1.4 leverage discussion in v0.2 lessons.

FLOOR_BREACH_tier.trigger: Stage 1 A_immune ≥ 1.10 OR concurrent BladderRef Epi NEGATIVE plus EC/Fib/IC POSITIVE pattern firing at |d|≥0.30 each
FLOOR_BREACH_tier.clinical_action: Urgent urology consult within 2 weeks regardless of symptom status. Cystoscopy + cytology + imaging. If positive disease confirmed, NMIBC vs MIBC staging per AJCC 8th edition determines downstream pathway (TURBT for Ta/T1 disease; intravesical BCG vs cystectomy decision for high-risk NMIBC; neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus cystectomy for MIBC).

pre_existing_diagnosis.post_treatment_monitoring_use_case: After TURBT or BCG treatment for NMIBC, serial Stage 2 BladderRef Epi readings produce a trajectory; A_Epi trending below the q5 healthy floor flags potential urothelial dedifferentiation drift consistent with recurrence risk. After radical cystectomy for MIBC, Stage 1 + Stage 3 immune-architectural drift trajectory may complement standard CT/MRI surveillance for distant recurrence — but per the v0.1 limitations, this use case is NOT validated by sealed Phase C data and is documented as a v0.3+ promotion-path research question.

card_does_NOT_provide: Standalone screening test for bladder cancer in asymptomatic populations (Stage 1 panel coverage limitation per VAL-120 + no pre-diagnostic blood cohort validation)
NMIBC vs MIBC stage discrimination (TCGA-BLCA Phase C analysis was not stage-stratified in v0.1)
Variant histology discrimination (squamous-differentiated, neuroendocrine, micropapillary not characterized)
PD-L1 / FGFR3 / nectin-4 biomarker prediction (not in EDEAR scope)
BCG vs intravesical chemotherapy treatment selection (not in EDEAR scope)
Multi-ancestry validation (TCGA-BLCA cohort ancestry composition not analyzed in v0.1)
Urine substrate clinical pathway (no urine cohort scored in v0.1; Bryan UK NMIBC and Chen 2022 NMIBC EPIC blood cohorts queued for v0.3+)

validation_tier_rationale: v0.2 promotes from stage_2_only_validated to multi_modal_validated + multi_atlas_calibrated. Anchored by: (1) VAL-119 EpiSCORE BladderRef Phase B calibration sealed O1 on TCGA-KIRC + TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal n=210 HM450K sesame Level 3 (four bladder cell types EC/Epi/Fib/IC, all CHK gates passed: CHK-3.1A 206/210 (98.1%), CHK-3.1B 210/210 (q5=86.15%), CHK-3.1C 0 duplicates across 2,696 unique probeIDs); (2) VAL-121 Stage 2 multi-atlas Phase C run-everything on TCGA-BLCA n=440 HM450K (21 paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal patients) sealed O2_BLADDER_TILE_DIFFERENTIATING_DIRECTION_AMBIGUOUS — BladderRef Epi paired d = -1.4623 (NEGATIVE, CCL-039 cell-of-origin direction expectation MET) plus Loyfer bulk Bladder paired d = +1.9100 (POSITIVE, substrate-distribution-mismatch artifact per DISC-BLADDER-003) plus BladderRef microenvironment EC/Fib/IC all POSITIVE consistent with CCL-039 microenvironment expansion expectation; (3) VAL-122 Stage 3 immune fine-tune sealed O1_STAGE_3_IMMUNE_DIFFERENTIATING — all 6 of 6 Salas IDOL tiles fire POSITIVE at |d_paired| range 0.49 to 1.24 consistent with mixed TIL+TAM+MDSC infiltration in muscle-invasive bladder tumor microenvironment. Stage 1 (VAL-120) sealed at O4_STAGE1_DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE on Xu-538 panel cohort-substrate coverage (51.1% per-sample pass) — diagnostic d_paired = +1.8977 reported as diagnostic finding, not as production-validated Stage 1 outcome. Stage 1 panel cohort-substrate-coverage validation (DISC-BLADDER-004 + CHK-2.17) and pre-diagnostic blood screening (WHI bladder pre-dx Jordahl 2018 n=440+440 biobank-gated) remain v0.3+ next-validation-steps. Three additional cookbook discoveries propagate from this sprint: DISC-BLADDER-001 (gene-promoter atlas family fitness depends on per-tissue cell-type DISTINCTNESS not COUNT — bladder's 4 cell types separated cleanly while cardio's 5 collapsed); DISC-BLADDER-002 (CHK-3.1A floors are tissue-class-dependent — solid parenchyma 0.50/0.12 vs mucosal 0.387/0.184); DISC-BLADDER-003 (bulk-WGBS atlases on mucosal-cohort substrates produce inflated cross-tile A-scores from substrate-distribution mismatch — CHK-2.18 cookbook gate).

primary_validation.cohort_phase_b_calibration: TCGA-KIRC + TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal n=210 HM450K sesame Level 3 (160 KIRC + 50 PRAD; same VAL-106 calibration cohort that anchored cardio + prostate)

primary_validation.primary_finding: BladderRef Epi gene-promoter cell-of-origin tile fires NEGATIVE at d_paired = -1.4623 (CCL-039 expectation MET); Loyfer bulk Bladder tile fires POSITIVE at d_paired = +1.9100 (substrate-distribution-mismatch artifact per DISC-BLADDER-003); BladderRef microenvironment EC/Fib/IC all fire POSITIVE consistent with CCL-039 microenvironment expansion. Stage 3 all 6 Salas IDOL immune-cell-type A-scores fire POSITIVE at |d| = 0.49 to 1.24.
primary_validation.primary_validation_status: v0.2 multi_modal_validated + multi_atlas_calibrated tier; Stage 1 production deployment requires v0.3 panel work

known_limitations: Stage 1 Xu-538 panel does not pass per-sample CHK-3.1B coverage threshold on TCGA-BLCA HM450K (51.1% pass rate at ≥80% threshold); v0.1 Stage 1 sealed O4 production-data-integrity-failure; diagnostic d=+1.90 reported as diagnostic only, not production-validated for bladder substrate; v0.3 promotion path requires bladder-cohort-coverage-validated Stage 1 panel.

Pre-diagnostic blood screening for bladder cancer not validated; WHI bladder pre-diagnostic cohort (Jordahl et al. 2018, n=440 cases + 440 matched controls, HM450 buffy coat, median 7.22 years pre-dx) is biobank-gated through WHI (Tier 3 access). v1.0+ next-validation-step.

TCGA-BLCA Phase C analysis not stage-stratified in v0.1; NMIBC vs MIBC subgroup analysis deferred to v0.3 pending stage metadata join; the broad-positive multi-atlas Stage 3 immune signature observed may resolve into pure-lymphoid-dominant (NMIBC subgroup, would replicate Chen 2022 NMIBC blood EPIC RFS pattern) vs pure-myeloid-dominant (advanced MIBC, MDSC infiltration) on stratified analysis.

Variant histology not separately characterized: squamous-differentiated, glandular, micropapillary, sarcomatoid, plasmacytoid, neuroendocrine variant histologies of urothelial carcinoma not stratified in v0.2.

Urine substrate not yet integrated; bladder is the cancer type most amenable to urine-cytology methylation panels (UroMark, Bladder EpiCheck, ADXBLADDER, Cheng 7-gene panel are clinical-grade comparators with AUC ranges 80-97% on voided urine), and urine outperforms blood for early bladder detection in the literature; v0.3+ promotion path includes urine cohort acquisition (Bryan UK NMIBC HM450 candidate; targeted bisulfite NGS via UroMark workflow integration).

Multi-ancestry validation pending; TCGA-BLCA cohort ancestry composition was not analyzed in v0.1 sealed work; the cohort is enriched for European-ancestry patients per general TCGA demographics but specific ancestry stratification was not pre-registered.

Smoking exposure stratification not pre-registered for v0.1; bladder cancer is heavily smoking-driven and Stage 1 immune signature in current/former smokers may carry the F2RL3/AHRR smoking-CpG confound documented in lung-epic CCL-009; bladder v0.3 should incorporate the same smoking-stratification discipline lung-epic uses.

EPIC 850K substrate-matched calibration anchor not yet sealed; v0.1 BladderRef Phase B calibration is on HM450K only; EPIC 850K substrate generalizability requires either a structurally-separated EPIC 850K healthy bladder cohort (none currently exists in public deposits at sufficient n) or within-cohort self-cal documentation per CCL-041 / DISC-CARDIO-005 — v0.3 promotion path.

Single-timepoint sensitivity at 95% specificity unknown; deployment model is multi-modal Stage 2 + Stage 3 anchored flagging with tier × clinical-context matrix, not standalone screening from a single Stage 1 score.

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained pipeline specification embedded in every card so a new analyst loading only this JSON plus GAPE_WEB_v13.py can run the full pipeline end-to-end without consulting any other file.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_formula: A_immune = H_pooled / H_min where H_pooled = -sum(b * log2(b) + (1-b) * log2(1-b)) / N over Xu-538 CpGs
universal_stage_1_pipeline.baseline_reference: 80-cell age-decade healthy baseline (Hannum 2013 + Horvath 2013 + Roadmap 2015 + Moss 2018 + Lister 2013 + Alisch 2012)

universal_stage_2_pipeline.scoring_formula_per_tile: A_tile = H_subset / H_min(class) where H_subset is pooled entropy on tile CpGs and class is per-cell-type architecture-class assignment

universal_stage_3_pipeline.scoring_formula: A_tile per immune cell type against H_min(immune) = 0.838889; broad-positive across 6/6 Salas IDOL tiles is the muscle-invasive bladder microenvironment signature observed in VAL-122

universal_reference.language_discipline: Card uses 'consistent with' / 'fires' / 'POSITIVE direction' / 'CCL-039 expectation MET'. Card does NOT use 'confirms' / 'validates' / 'proves' / 'diagnoses'. Bladder-epic is a flag that changes downstream urology workup; final diagnosis requires cystoscopy plus tissue biopsy plus pathology per AUA/EAU standard of care.
universal_reference.cross_cohort_batch_offset_warning: Per VAL-057 cookbook lesson, cross-cohort comparisons require platform-match + preprocessing-pipeline-match + within-platform batch-correction-anchor; none of these conditions were tested in v0.1 (single TCGA-BLCA cohort only); v0.3 multi-cohort work must verify CCL-037 three-condition test before cross-cohort paired-d computations.
universal_reference.commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali: Per CCL-037 (lung-epic v0.5 standard, propagated to bladder-epic v0.2), EDEAR commercial deployment is single-pipeline patient-vs-internal-reference scoring against the public Loyfer/Moss/Tanaka atlases anchored through L1 partner-lab pipeline calibration. The cross-cohort calibration boundary documented in CCL-037 applies exclusively to retrospective Cookbook validation, not to per-patient deployment scoring. The DISC-BLADDER-003 mucosal-cohort atlas-family rule applies to retrospective Cookbook validation on heterogeneous β panels; per-patient deployment uses a single-pipeline single-substrate scoring loop where the substrate-distribution-mismatch artifact does not arise.

lessons_learned.title: Gene-promoter atlas family fitness depends on cell-type DISTINCTNESS, not COUNT
lessons_learned.source_validation: VAL-119 (BladderRef Phase B calibration on TCGA n=210)
lessons_learned.context: After cardio VAL-111 HeartRef collapsed to O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED (5 cell types CM/EC/FB/MP/SMC, max within-cohort range 0.0152) while prostate VAL-117 ProstateRef separated cleanly (6 cell types BE/EC/Fib/LE/Leu/SM, max within-cohort range 0.0597), the open question was whether cell-type count predicted atlas family fitness.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: BladderRef separated cleanly with ONLY 4 cell types (EC/Epi/Fib/IC, max within-cohort range 0.0694) — LARGER separation than ProstateRef's 6 cell types. This falsifies the count-predicts-fitness hypothesis.
lessons_learned.interpretation: The discriminating variable is per-tissue cell-type DISTINCTNESS at the gene-promoter level for the marker genes Zhu/Teschendorff selected. Bladder's 4 compartments (urothelial barrier-secretory epithelium, intra-bladder vasculature, fibroblast stroma, intra-bladder immune) ARE markedly distinct gene-promoter programs even though there are fewer of them. Cardiac cell types share substantial gene-promoter methylation similarity at the marker-gene level despite being 5 in number.
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: Each EpiSCORE per-tissue bridge calibration is smoke-tested independently; outcome cannot be predicted from source-matrix dimensions alone. DISC-BLADDER-001 propagates as third atlas-family-fitness data point (extends DISC-CARDIO-004 + DISC-PROSTATE-001).

lessons_learned.title: CHK-3.1A f_extreme floor is tissue-class-dependent, not universal
lessons_learned.source_validation: VAL-120 + VAL-121 + VAL-122 (sealed amendment 002 chain on TCGA-BLCA n=440)
lessons_learned.context: Original prereg locked CHK-3.1A f_extreme floor at ≥0.50 (kidney+prostate-derived from VAL-106 sealed baseline 55.87% ± 2.44%). Pass rate on bladder cohort under that floor: 23.9%.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: Bladder cohort observed f_extreme 47.2% ± 4.85%, with bladder adjacent-normal at 49.5% — the entire cohort sits below the kidney/prostate-derived floor by ~6 percentage points. TSS-site analysis confirmed cohort-wide unimodal-shifted distribution (not bimodal-batch-mixed). Zero samples have genuine substrate corruption.
lessons_learned.interpretation: Bladder mucosa (urothelium plus lamina propria) has a substantially less bimodal methylation distribution than solid kidney/prostate parenchyma. This is a tissue-architecture fact, not a data-integrity issue. The CHK-3.1A floor was set on solid-parenchyma data and applied verbatim to bladder; the gate fired 76% on a cohort where 0% have actual data integrity problems.
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: Amendment 002 corrected the floor to bladder-cohort q1/q99 envelope (f_extreme ≥ 0.387, f_middle ≤ 0.184). Pass rate under amended floor: 98.0%. DISC-BLADDER-002 propagates as CHK-2.16 cookbook gate: tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor verification at prereg-write time, not inherited implicitly. Solid parenchyma (kidney, prostate, breast, liver, thyroid) ~55%; mucosal/epithelial-lined-organ tissues (bladder, lung-airways, colon, cervical, esophagus, stomach, GI-epithelium, oral-mucosa) lower because of barrier-secretory architecture.

lessons_learned.title: Bulk-WGBS atlases on mucosal-cohort substrates produce inflated cross-tile A-scores
lessons_learned.source_validation: VAL-121 (Stage 2 multi-atlas Phase C on TCGA-BLCA n=440)
lessons_learned.context: Run-everything across three calibrated Stage 2 atlases (Loyfer 25-tile, EpiSCORE BladderRef 4-tile, Caggiano TIM 19-tile) on the same 21 paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal patients.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: Loyfer bulk Bladder tile fired POSITIVE +1.91 paired d while EpiSCORE BladderRef Epi (urothelial gene-promoter) fired NEGATIVE -1.46 paired d on the same paired pairs — high-magnitude direction divergence. CHK-3.2 cross-tile sanity flagged ALL 14 Loyfer non-bladder solid-tissue tiles as POSITIVE FIRES at +2.34 to +2.92 (Thyroid, Pancreas, Cortical_neurons, Uterus_cervix, Upper_GI, Kidney, Lung, Breast, Head_and_neck, Hepatocytes, Prostate, Colon all firing inflated POSITIVE).
lessons_learned.interpretation: The bulk-tissue WGBS reference encodes mixed-cell-type β profiles (urothelium + lamina propria + vasculature + stroma + immune together) and produces |β_sample − β_bulk_ref| dominated by substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohorts. The cross-tile inflation across all 14 non-bladder tiles confirms this is substrate-distribution mismatch, not cross-tissue biology. Gene-promoter sub-cell-type references encode signature β profiles for specific cell types and avoid this artifact.
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: Multi-atlas readings on mucosal cohorts MUST include a gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas as the primary cell-of-origin reader. Single-atlas Stage 2 readings on mucosal cohorts using bulk-WGBS references can be substrate-substitution-fooled. DISC-BLADDER-003 propagates as CHK-2.18 cookbook gate: tissue class ∈ {bladder, lung-airways, colon, cervical, esophagus, stomach, GI-epithelium, oral-mucosa} AND primary cell-of-origin reader's atlas family is bulk-WGBS → REQUIRE at least one gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas (EpiSCORE per-tissue bridge) in atlases_run as the primary cell-of-origin reader.

lessons_learned.title: Stage 1 panel cohort-substrate coverage is panel-specific and cohort-specific
lessons_learned.context: The Xu-538 panel is breast-cancer-derived (Sister Study + EPIC-Italy replication, Xu 2020 JNCI djz065). All 538 panel CpGs are HM450-design CpGs and the panel passed VAL-058 prostate validation cleanly.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: On TCGA-BLCA HM450K sesame Level 3, panel mean per-sample coverage was only 78.0% with 51.1% pass rate at the ≥80% per-sample CHK-3.1B threshold. The panel CpGs are all platform-applicable but per-sample coverage drops cohort-specifically due to TSS-site methylation-detection-pass variability.
lessons_learned.interpretation: Stage 1 panel transferability is cohort-specific, not platform-specific. A panel can be HM450-design-validated and still fail per-sample coverage on a specific cohort due to TSS-site variation in detection pass. The Xu-538 panel was not pre-validated on TCGA-BLCA before being deployed.
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: DISC-BLADDER-004 propagates as CHK-2.17 cookbook gate: Stage 1 panels must be validated against the target Phase C cohort's substrate-coverage envelope at prereg-write time. Validation procedure: sample 5-10 random Phase C cohort β files, compute per-sample panel coverage, FLAG if mean < 90% or q5 < 80%. Production Stage 1 deployment for bladder requires v0.3 bladder-cohort-coverage-validated panel.

lessons_learned.title: Patient-flow sprint structure (Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3) is the right execution order
lessons_learned.source_validation: VAL-120 → VAL-121 → VAL-122 patient-flow execution chain
lessons_learned.context: The bladder-epic v0.1 sprint executed in patient-flow order matching how a patient walks through the lab: Stage 1 immune red flag first, Stage 2 cell-of-origin localization second, Stage 3 immune fine-tune third.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: Each stage's prereg was sealed before the next stage's β read, with the unified Phase C runner producing all three stages' per-sample tables in a single 270.7-second pass on n=440 cohort. The patient-flow order surfaced the Stage 1 panel-coverage limitation first (gating the Stage 1 outcome), then the Stage 2 atlas-direction-divergence finding (DISC-BLADDER-003), then the Stage 3 broad immune signature — exactly the order an oncologist would interpret a patient's results.
lessons_learned.interpretation: Patient-flow execution order produces a more clinically interpretable narrative than running stages out of order or in parallel without staging. The natural narrative for a future oncologist or AI 2 years from now reading the EDEAR output is: did the immune red flag fire? if yes, where does Stage 2 localize? what does Stage 3 immune fine-tune say about the microenvironment?
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: Patient-flow sprint structure (Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3) is the canonical execution order for all future card sprints. Documented in CROSS_CARD_CALIBRATION_TODO_v0_7 as the bladder-epic reference example.

lessons_learned.title: Honest amendment 002 path under CCL-041 second-best disclosure
lessons_learned.source_validation: VAL-120/121/122 amendment 002 chain (CHK-3.1A tissue-class floor correction)
lessons_learned.context: Original CHK-3.1A floor was specified in the prereg (sealed before β read) using the kidney/prostate-derived ≥0.50 baseline. After β observed, 76% of bladder samples failed the gate. CCL-041 forbids post-hoc threshold relaxation.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: The pre-locked outcome class O4_STAGE1_DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE would have fired under the original floor, but the Stage 1 paired contrast d=+1.90 was real biology (heavy TIL infiltration consistent with bladder cancer literature). Sealing at O4 with that label would have been technically prereg-compliant but factually misleading — the failure was tissue-class-floor-mismatch, not data-integrity-failure.
lessons_learned.interpretation: CCL-041 has a 'second-best path': when a post-hoc structural specification correction is needed AND the correction is justified by data-independent criteria (tissue-class structural specification error caught by cohort baseline statistics, not by the contrast we want to fire), an honest amendment with full disclosure is the right discipline answer. Amendment 002 was sealed with timestamp + SHA + DATA_OBSERVED_BEFORE_AMENDMENT=YES + LESSON_LOGGED + COOKBOOK_PROPOSAL fields all explicit.
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: The amendment 002 chain is the cookbook reference for the CCL-041 second-best path. Future card sprints encountering tissue-class structural specification errors caught by cohort baseline statistics may follow the same chain. This is NOT a blanket permission to relax thresholds post-hoc — the path requires (a) the correction is justified by structural specification error, (b) the correction is parameterized on data-independent statistics (cohort baseline shape, not the outcome contrast), (c) full disclosure including DATA_OBSERVED_BEFORE_AMENDMENT field, (d) cookbook lesson logged.

lessons_learned.title: Mucosal-tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor envelope replicates structurally across mucosal organs
lessons_learned.source_validation: VAL-119/120/121/122 chain establishes the mucosal envelope; retroactive applicability to lung/CRC/cervical pending v0.3+ confirmation
lessons_learned.context: The bladder cohort q1/q99 floor (f_extreme ≥ 0.387, f_middle ≤ 0.184) was empirically derived from TCGA-BLCA. Per CHK-2.16, future mucosal-tissue cards (lung-airways, colon, cervical, esophagus, stomach, GI-epithelium, oral-mucosa) need their own per-cohort q1/q99 verification.
lessons_learned.observed_quirk: Lung-epic VAL-097 (cross-cohort run-everything on TCGA-LUAD adjacent-normal vs GSE256092 Korean LUAD) sealed O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED with breach pattern (22 of 25 Loyfer tiles uniformly positive, 11 of 25 >3 anchor-SD) — structurally consistent with the bladder mucosal-cohort substrate-distribution-mismatch signature on bulk-WGBS atlases. CRC-epic three-cohort confirmation (VAL-062 + VAL-098 + VAL-099) shows full-HM450 cycling-class positive while Colon_epithelial_cells run-everything tile reads strongly negative across COAD/READ/COAD-revisit at d −1.55 to −2.50 — also structurally consistent with substrate-distribution mismatch (CCL-039 cell-of-origin tile fidelity degradation framing and DISC-BLADDER-003 substrate-mismatch framing both reach the same observed direction).
lessons_learned.interpretation: The mucosal-tissue-class envelope discovered in bladder appears to replicate across other mucosal organs. Per the v0.5.1 lung-epic and v2.4.1 crc-epic retroactive flag amendments, the existing sealed VAL outcomes for VAL-056/063/097 (lung) and VAL-061/062/098/099 (CRC) stand — but future Stage 2 work for these cards must use gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlases (EpiSCORE LungRef, EpiSCORE ColonRef) as primary cell-of-origin readers per CHK-2.18, with bulk-WGBS atlases triangulation-only.
lessons_learned.how_card_updated: EpiSCORE LungRef and EpiSCORE ColonRef bridge engineering queues for the next lung-epic and crc-epic Stage 2 sprints respectively. Same Entrez-gene-ID → 450K-CpG bridge methodology as HeartRef (VAL-111), ProstateRef (VAL-117), BladderRef (VAL-119). Phase B mini-calibration on TCGA-KIRC + TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal n=210 sealed before any disease-cohort scoring per CHK-2.7 magnitude-based |d| thresholds with direction labels.

stage_2_results_val_121.sealing_basis: Loyfer bulk Bladder POSITIVE +1.91 vs BladderRef Epi NEGATIVE -1.46 — high-magnitude direction divergence

cell_of_origin_paired_contrasts.interpretation: urothelial-program loss in tumor; structurally identical to prostate VAL-118 LE-NEGATIVE pattern

stage_2_results_val_121.chk_3_2_interpretation: ALL 14 non-bladder solid-tissue Loyfer tiles fire POSITIVE FLAGGED at d_paired +2.34 to +2.92 — uniform inflation across all non-cohort references. This is the substrate-distribution-mismatch signal per DISC-BLADDER-003, NOT cross-tissue biology. Bladder tumor is not 'becoming Thyroid + Pancreas + Liver simultaneously'. The bulk-WGBS reference β profiles are uniformly far from the bladder cohort's tissue-class methylation distribution shape, producing inflated |β_sample − β_bulk_ref| metrics across all bulk solid-tissue tiles. The Loyfer Bladder POSITIVE +1.91 sits within this same inflated band (it is actually the LOWEST of the solid-tissue Loyfer tile readings, suggesting the residual signal is the bladder-specific component minus the substrate-mismatch baseline).

stage_3_results_val_122.sealing_basis: All 6 of 6 Salas IDOL 6-cell tiles fire POSITIVE at |d_paired| ≥ 0.30; pre-locked O2 (lymphoid-dominant) and O3 (myeloid-dominant) did NOT fire — broad infiltration pattern instead
stage_3_results_val_122.biological_interpretation: broad immune-architectural drift across all six Salas IDOL tiles consistent with mixed TIL+TAM+MDSC infiltration in muscle-invasive bladder tumor microenvironment. NOT lymphoid-dominant (Chen 2022 NMIBC blood EPIC RFS pattern; would have required Mono/Neu NEGATIVE FIRES). NOT myeloid-dominant (advanced/MIBC MDSC pattern; would have required CD4T/CD8T NEGATIVE FIRES). The 6/6 broad-positive signature is the more biologically realistic mixed-infiltration pattern characteristic of muscle-invasive bladder cancer.

discoveries.title: Gene-promoter atlas family fitness depends on cell-type DISTINCTNESS, not cell-type COUNT
discoveries.evidence: Cardio HeartRef (5 cell types CM/EC/FB/MP/SMC) → O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED, max within-cohort range 0.0152. Prostate ProstateRef (6 cell types BE/EC/Fib/LE/Leu/SM) → O1 sealed, max within-cohort range 0.0597. Bladder BladderRef (4 cell types EC/Epi/Fib/IC) → O1 sealed, max within-cohort range 0.0694. Cell-type count does not predict outcome; cell-type distinctness at the gene-promoter marker-gene level does.
discoveries.cookbook_propagation: Each EpiSCORE per-tissue bridge calibration must be smoke-tested independently per VAL-094/111/117/119 protocol; tissue distinctness at the gene-promoter level is not predictable a priori from EpiSCORE source-matrix dimensions.

discoveries.title: CHK-3.1A f_extreme floor is tissue-class-dependent, not universal
discoveries.evidence: VAL-106 kidney+prostate-derived solid-parenchyma floor (≥0.50/≤0.12) failed on 76% of bladder samples; bladder cohort q1/q99 (≥0.387/≤0.184) passes 98%. Bladder mucosa has substantially less bimodal methylation distribution than solid kidney/prostate parenchyma — a tissue-architecture fact, not a data-integrity issue.
discoveries.cookbook_propagation: CHK-2.16 cookbook gate: at prereg-write time, every card specifies the tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor; do not inherit implicitly. Solid parenchyma class uses VAL-106 floor (≥0.50/≤0.12); mucosal class uses VAL-120 amendment 002 floor (≥0.387/≤0.184). Future tissue classes require per-tissue-class verification at first card encounter.
discoveries.affected_cohorts_retroactively: Lung-epic VAL-097 (mucosal lung tissue), CRC-epic VAL-061/062/098/099 (mucosal colon tissue) — flagged in retroactive amendment per option-(a) documentation-only path; sealed outcomes stand

discoveries.title: Bulk-WGBS atlases on mucosal-cohort substrates produce inflated cross-tile A-scores
discoveries.evidence: Loyfer bulk Bladder POSITIVE +1.91 vs BladderRef Epi NEGATIVE -1.46 on same n=21 paired pairs (high-magnitude direction divergence); CHK-3.2 cross-tile sanity flags ALL 14 Loyfer non-bladder solid-tissue tiles as POSITIVE FIRES at d_paired +2.34 to +2.92 (Thyroid, Pancreas, Cortical_neurons, Uterus_cervix, Upper_GI, Kidney, Lung, Breast, Head_and_neck, Hepatocytes, Prostate, Colon all uniformly inflated).
discoveries.interpretation: The bulk-tissue WGBS reference encodes mixed-cell-type β profiles and produces |β_sample − β_bulk_ref| dominated by substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohorts. Cross-tile inflation across all 14 non-bladder tiles confirms substrate-distribution mismatch, not cross-tissue biology. Gene-promoter sub-cell-type references encode signature β profiles for specific cell types and avoid this artifact.
discoveries.cookbook_propagation: CHK-2.18 cookbook gate: tissue class ∈ {bladder, lung-airways, colon, cervical, esophagus, stomach, GI-epithelium, oral-mucosa} AND primary cell-of-origin reader's atlas family is bulk-WGBS → REQUIRE at least one gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas (EpiSCORE per-tissue bridge) in atlases_run as the primary cell-of-origin reader. Bulk-WGBS atlases stay in atlases_run for triangulation but cannot be the headline signal. If no validated gene-promoter atlas exists for the tissue, the card defers.
discoveries.retroactive_card_amendments: lung-epic v0.5.1 retroactive flag (covers VAL-056/063/097); crc-epic v2.4.1 retroactive flag (covers VAL-061/062/098/099); cervical-epic forward-looking flag (no Stage 2 cell-of-origin VAL sealed yet)

discoveries.title: Stage 1 panel cohort-substrate coverage is panel-specific and cohort-specific
discoveries.evidence: Xu-538 panel (HM450-design, breast-derived from Xu 2020 Sister Study) showed 78.0% mean per-sample coverage with 51.1% pass rate at ≥80% per-sample threshold on TCGA-BLCA. The panel CpGs are platform-applicable but per-sample coverage drops cohort-specifically due to TSS-site methylation-detection-pass variability.
discoveries.cookbook_propagation: CHK-2.17 cookbook gate: Stage 1 panels must be validated against the target Phase C cohort's substrate-coverage envelope at prereg-write time. Validation procedure: sample 5-10 random Phase C cohort β files, compute per-sample panel coverage, FLAG if mean < 90% or q5 < 80%.
